instruction: Help me launch the Edge-Detect filter dialog.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to open the Edge-Detect filter window in GIMP. The evaluator verifies that 'filters-edge' appears in GIMP's action history. Same complexity and structure as original task.
metadata.verification: The evaluator checks that 'filters-edge' appears in the GIMP action history. Uses existing check_include_exclude function.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic gap: Instruction requires 'launching the Edge-Detect filter dialog' but evaluator verifies if filter action appears in GIMP action-history
GIMP action-history typically records filter executions/applications, not just dialog openings
Opening a dialog without applying the filter may not be recorded in action-history, causing false negatives
The evaluator cannot reliably distinguish between 'dialog opened but not applied' vs 'dialog not opened at all'
Postconfig closes GIMP (Ctrl+Q) before verification, relying on action-history persistence, which is correct but doesn't solve the dialog-vs-execution semantic mismatch
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Use accessibility tree getter (get_accessibility_tree) with check_accessibility_tree metric to verify the Edge-Detect dialog window is actually visible/open
OR modify the instruction to require applying/executing the Edge-Detect filter, not just opening the dialog
OR empirically verify that GIMP records dialog openings (not just filter executions) in action-history before relying on this verification approach
Consider using window title detection or UI element verification instead of action-history for dialog-opening tasks
